audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. The printed cumulative definition omits the initial reduction and pairs the kernel with the wrong cumulative step.; The stated Portmanteau bound is false for signed measures, even with uniformly bounded total variation.; Lemma14 overstates rational density/probability and does not supply the positive boundary-avoiding approximation required in Lemma31.
limitations: F1 — Counterevidence: The correctly indexed telescope restores agreement with Theorem80. This is not a counterexample to the corrected main orbit-equivalence theorem.
F2 — Counterevidence: This does not refute Proposition73: its exceptional set is null for every positive invariant measure, allowing Jordan-limit repair.

F3 — Counterevidence: Real-coefficient and rational null-homology approximations are available but do not jointly supply positivity and avoidance. The explicit suspension examples do not meet the skewed main theorem's hypotheses.
F4 — Counterevidence: The local formula f=g/T gives the desired time and f=2 in this example. This is not a counterexample to atlas existence.
F5 — Counterevidence: The lemma's inequality follows unchanged from the probability Leb_gamma/T, whose entropy is zero.
F6 — Counterevidence: Replacing S by C-sum_i e_i simultaneously restores partial S=Gamma and the positive C intersection. It leaves the intended LR formula consistent.

F7 — Counterevidence: The paper explicitly discusses suspension cases; a vacuous positivity convention or extended infimum makes the intended usage meaningful. An invariant positive volume in a suspension has nonzero homology, so this does not create a false Reeb volume.

Limits: All 73 source text pages were read; 44 actual source images were inspected. This does not certify every external theorem or the entire signed weak-topology continuity claim. Main theorem not independently refuted; corrected global proof not independently completed. No journal-version equivalence established.
Limitations: Exact author manuscript retained separately from the journal title/version.

Limitations: Full joint signed weak-topology continuity, positive-avoidance construction, global atlas compatibility and external Anosov theorems remain unverified beyond the indicated bounded checks.
Limitations: Native auxiliary's earlier repair-based severity suggestions were superseded by its actual dependency follow-up; no human review is asserted.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.

proposition.claim:
The printed cumulative definition omits the initial reduction and pairs the kernel with the wrong cumulative step.

The stated Portmanteau bound is false for signed measures, even with uniformly bounded total variation.

Lemma14 overstates rational density/probability and does not supply the positive boundary-avoiding approximation required in Lemma31.

The printed multiplicative time-change formula does not yield the asserted return time.

An unnormalized orbit measure is used as a probability competitor.

The orientation of the printed spanning chain is reversed.

The minimum over null-homologous probability measures needs an empty-set convention.
